Are you passionate about pharma-Logistics? Do you have experience within global cold chain and GxP shipping?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Senior Associate, Global Logistics & Distribution

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking a passionate Senior Associate to join our growing team. As a key member of the Ascendis Pharma team, you will play a crucial role in Global Logistics This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment, collaborate with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results.

You will join the Global Logistics team consisting of 5 colleagues, and report directly to Aske Engsbro-Jansson, Associate Director who is based in Hellerup. You will be based in Hellerup.

Your key responsibilities will be:

Logistics Operations

• Coordinate daily shipping activities and ensure timely collection and delivery of GxP shipments

• Communicate clearly and accurately with third-party vendors

Compliance & Documentation

• Ensure all transportation and storage activities comply with GDP and regulatory requirements

Stakeholder Collaboration

• Guide, train, and support colleagues on shipping procedures and requirements

• Resolve logistics issues with internal and external partners

Continuous Improvement

• Identify and implement process improvements

Qualifications and Skills:

You have a minimum of 5 years' experience in Logistics, preferably within the biotech, pharmaceutical or other regulated industry (e.g., food, medical devices)

Furthermore, you have:

• Strong knowledge of international logistics, cold chain shipping, and GxP/GDP requirements

• Experience with customs and VAT requirements, shipping documentation, and third-party logistics

• Proficiency in English and Danish (written and spoken)

• Solid skills in Microsoft Office; experience with ERP systems (e.g., Microsoft D365) is an advantage

• Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills

Key competencies:

You are a person who understands the value of teamwork and appreciates the strengths that come from collaborating with colleagues who bring diverse competencies, perspectives, and experiences

You possess a positive mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation is key.

To excel in this position, you should demonstrate strong cross-functional collaboration, maintain a proactive approach, and be adaptable to changing priorities, challenges, and business needs.

Travel: 5-15 days per year.

Office: Denmark, DK2900 Hellerup, Tuborg Boulevard 12

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform - applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For more details about the position or the company, please contact Aske Engsbro-Jansson, Associate Director, Global Logistics

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website www.ascendispharma.com

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

A note to recruiters:

We do not allow external search party solicitation. Presentation of candidates without written permission from the Ascendis Pharma HR team (specifically from: Talent Acquisition Partner or Human Resources Director) is not allowed. If this occurs, your ownership of these candidates will not be acknowledged.

**About The Job

**Flatpay has become one of the fastest-growing payment companies by helping merchants accept payments in-store. Now we're taking the next step.

Online is one of Flatpay's newest and most strategic engineering domains. We're building the products and platforms that enable merchants to accept payments online and grow their businesses in the digital economy.

As a Software Engineer, you'll help build and launch new products, contribute to technical discussions and decisions, and scale solutions as adoption grows across new markets.

This is a unique opportunity to join at an early stage. While Flatpay already serves merchants at scale, our online platform is still in its early stages. You'll have the opportunity to help launch new solutions, shape how the platform evolves as adoption grows, and learn directly from customers along the way.

If you enjoy building products from the ground up, working close to customers, and seeing your work evolve from first launch to large-scale adoption, you'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact in a domain that will play an important role in Flatpay's future growth.

**What You'll Do

**

• Design, develop, and maintain software solutions for online commerce and payments

• Build new merchant- and customer-facing features, APIs, and services

• Take ownership of features from design and implementation through deployment and maintenance

• Improve the reliability, scalability, and performance of existing systems

• Collaborate with product managers and designers to deliver customer value

• Participate in technical discussions, code reviews, and architecture decisions

• Contribute to testing, deployment, and operational excellence

• Work closely with other engineering teams across Flatpay to build integrated solutions

• Help improve engineering practices, tooling, and development workflows

**Who You Are

**

• 3-6 years of professional software engineering experience

• Experience building and operating production systems

• Comfortable working across modern backend and cloud technologies

• Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals

• Curious, pragmatic, and eager to learn

• Enjoy taking ownership and solving real customer problems

• Experience with payments, e-commerce, SaaS platforms, or fintech is a plus

You'll be working with technologies such as the following.

We don't expect experience with every technology listed below. We're looking for engineers who can learn quickly and help us build great products.

**Backend

**

• Java, Spring Boot

• MySQL

• REST APIs & Event-Driven Architecture

• Domain Driven Design

• Docker, AWS

**Frontend

**

• TypeScript

• React

• TanStack Query

• Jest

• Playwright

• i18n, feature flags

**Platform & Delivery

**

• GitHub Actions

• CI/CD

• AWS ECS

• Observability & Monitoring

**Why Flatpay?

**As part of our team, you'll join 2,000+ passionate Flatpayers dedicated to shaping the future of payments. You'll help build a strategic new business area from the ground up, working on products that directly connect merchants and consumers while shaping the future of online payments at Flatpay. We offer an inclusive environment where engineers are trusted with ownership and encouraged to make an impact.

Our engineering teams work together from our Copenhagen office. We believe that close collaboration, quick feedback loops, and solving problems side-by-side help us build better products, move faster, and create a stronger engineering culture.

We also provide plenty of perks including free slush ice, an on-site gym, a fully equipped gamer room, and much more.

If you're ready to help build and scale the future of payments, we'd love to hear from you.

Established in 2022 in Copenhagen with a commitment to transparency, we've streamlined card payments to small and medium-sized businesses. Our innovative pricing model eliminates hidden costs and fees, offering a simple flat rate for all cards with no monthly subscription for our point-of-sale and payment solutions.

Operating in Denmark, Finland, Germany, Italy, France, the United Kingdom, and the Netherlands, we're more than just a service provider; we are your trusted business partner.

We continuously strive to stay ahead of the curve, adapting our solutions to meet our clients' evolving needs. Ready to be part of something extraordinary?

**This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of Creative Operations at Pandora. You will play a critical role in building the processes, systems, and capabilities that enable exceptional creative work at a global scale. Working across Brand Creative, Production, Marketing, and Technology, you will help define how creativity is delivered in a modern, technology-enabled organization while driving meaningful impact across the business.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

**What You Will Do

• Work hands-on across problem framing, research, interaction design, prototyping, visual design, validation, and implementation.

• Use AI throughout the design process to expand exploration, accelerate learning, and make ideas tangible faster.

• Partner with stakeholders across teams to bring customer insight, data, business goals, and technical trade-offs into decisions and alignment.

• Identify gaps in customer journeys and shared web patterns, then work with the relevant teams to make practical improvements.

• Create frameworks, prototypes, and reusable guidance, and provide constructive feedback that helps other designers and teams deliver high-quality work.

**What You Could Bring

**

• 10+ years of experience in product design with a strong track record of designing and shipping sophisticated web products and leading complex work involving multiple teams.

• Deep expertise in responsive design, interaction patterns, information architecture, accessibility, and visual craft.

• Demonstrated experience using AI tools in real design work, with the curiosity to continually explore new capabilities and practices.

• Strong product judgment, connecting customer needs, business goals, data, and technical constraints while navigating ambiguity.

• A systems mindset, including experience evolving design systems, shared patterns, and fragmented experiences.

• Strong communication, facilitation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence decisions and help peers improve their work.

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

**Our story goes back more than 150 years, to the chilly southern coast of Scandinavia. From our early success in Sweden and Denmark, we’ve grown into the world’s leading specialist producer of plant-based oils, employing more than 4,000 people across the globe.

We work with our customers to make the products you love even better. The oils we produce go into making your chocolate extra-creamy or putting the crunch into your croissant. And it’s not just food — we work across industries to make products that are higher quality, healthier and better for the planet.

Everything we do is about **Making Better Happen™.

****AAK Location

**This role will be based at our site in Aarhus.

**About The Role

**We are looking for a Global Application Excellence Manager to join AAK’s Applied Innovation organisation and serve as one of our global technical authorities within Chocolate & Confectionery Fats (CCF). Combining deep expertise in confectionery formulation, fat functionality and processing with innovation and industry knowledge, you will help strengthen AAK’s position as The Co-Development Company.

In this role, you will expand and strengthen AAK’s application knowledge by developing and validating customer-relevant proof points, leading lower-complexity product development projects and supporting Scientists on medium- and long-term innovation programmes. You will translate technical expertise into practical customer solutions that demonstrate the value of AAK’s portfolio.

Working alongside our other Global Application Excellence Manager – Chocolate & Confectionery, you will connect regional application experts, Customer Innovation teams, global functions and external industry stakeholders. You will help ensure knowledge and expertise are shared across regions, while identifying customer needs and market opportunities that can be translated into differentiated solutions and future innovation.

As a global technical reference point, you will support regional teams through technical guidance, training, customer projects and troubleshooting. You will also contribute to the development of AAK’s Confectionery Centre of Excellence and Customer Innovation Network, helping build capabilities and consistent application expertise across the organisation.

**Responsibilities

**

• Act as a global subject matter expert in Chocolate & Confectionery applications, with deep knowledge of CCF formulation, fat functionality, processing technologies and ingredient interactions.

• Connect regional application experts, Customer Innovation teams and global technical functions to strengthen knowledge sharing and ensure expertise is effectively leveraged across AAK.

• Design, develop and validate compelling application proof points that demonstrate customer value and differentiate AAK’s solutions.

• Lead lower-complexity product development projects while supporting Scientists on more complex, medium- and long-term innovation programmes.

• Translate new products and technologies into customer demonstrations, application evidence, technical documentation and materials that support successful commercialisation.

• Support regional teams with complex application and processing challenges through troubleshooting, technical guidance, customer workshops, factory trials and evaluations.

• Strengthen the Confectionery Centre of Excellence by developing application methods, evaluation protocols, best practices, technical tools and knowledge resources.

• Deliver AAK Academy training and technical learning programmes while supporting the development of the CCF Customer Innovation Network and wider technical capabilities.

• Analyse customer innovation projects and market developments to identify recurring needs, application gaps, future proof points and opportunities for new product development.

• Represent AAK within the wider confectionery ecosystem through relationships with suppliers, equipment manufacturers and industry experts, while supporting technology scouting and competitive benchmarking.

• Contribute to intellectual property activities, including technical evidence, application validation and competitive differentiation where relevant.

**About You

**

• MSc or PhD in Food Science, Food Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline.

• 8–10+ years of relevant industry experience within chocolate, confectionery, specialty fats or related food applications.

• Recognised expertise in Chocolate & Confectionery Fats, including formulation, fat functionality, ingredient interactions and processing technologies across applications such as chocolate, compounds, fillings, spreads and caramel.

• Proven experience in application development, product development, scale-up, customer trials and commercialisation.

• Ability to translate customer needs, market trends and technical knowledge into differentiated application solutions and compelling customer value.

• Experience working across global, cross-functional organisations, connecting technical experts and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

• Strong troubleshooting, process optimisation and communication skills, with a passion for knowledge sharing, capability building and mentoring.

• Experience with innovation processes, technology scouting, competitive benchmarking or intellectual property activities is an advantage; fluent in English and willing to travel internationally.

**In return AAK offers

**

• Join a pioneering company in specialty oils and fats, driving innovation and sustainability.

• In AAK you can work across 25+ countries, gaining international exposure and collaborating with a diverse team.

• AAK invests in your development with training, mentorship, and clear career paths.

• You will contribute to a greener world with AAK's sustainability-focused approach.

• Join a diverse and inclusive workplace that values every individual's perspective and talents.

**Contact and information

**For further information about the position, please contact Emily Lumb, Talent Acquisition Specialist: emily.lumb@aak.com

**About AAK

**Everything AAK does is about Making Better Happen™. We specialise in plant-based oils that are the value-adding ingredients in many of the products people love to consume. We make these products better tasting, healthier, and more sustainable.

At the heart of AAK’s offer is Customer Co-Development, combining our desire to understand what better means for each customer with the flexibility of our production assets and deep knowledge across multiple industries, including Chocolate and Confectionery, Bakery, Dairy, Plant-based Foods, Special Nutrition, Foodservice and Personal Care.

Our 4,000 employees support close collaboration with customers through 25 regional sales offices, 15 dedicated Customer Innovation Centers, and more than 20 production facilities worldwide. Headquartered in Malmö, Sweden and listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, AAK has been Making Better Happen™ for more than 150 years.

AAK is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diversity is valued and everyone has the opportunity to contribute and grow.

measurable business outcomes. We are looking for a Director to lead the AI & Data Advisory team, combining

management consulting leadership, commercial accountability, people management and a strong understanding

of AI and data in regulated environments.

conversations, originates and converts opportunities, delivers high-quality management consulting

engagements and develops relevant offerings based on market demand. The role sits in AI & Data Advisory

under Advisory & AI and works across R&D, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and cross-functional regulated

capabilities and connects client needs to NNIT domain and technology specialists, including the AI Factory in

the Philippines.

into bookings and revenue. Maintain visibility of pipeline, utilization, delivery outlook and capability needs, and

intervene early where progress is off track.

across life sciences. Lead strategic client conversations, frame business challenges, build executive alignment

and position NNIT as a trusted management consulting partner for AI- and data-enabled transformation.

_Do you want to join a global fund manager in energy infrastructure investments? If so, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) is currently looking for an Associate/Sr. Associate to join our Flagship Portfolio Management Team based in Copenhagen.

**Team

**The Flagship Portfolio Management team sits at the heart of our investment platform, overseeing the performance, strategy, and long‑term value creation of our largest and most strategic funds. The team manages the full lifecycle of portfolio assets by monitoring financial and operational performance, analyzing market and asset‑level developments, identifying risks and opportunities, and ensuring alignment with fund strategy. Working closely with investment teams, asset managers, and senior leadership, the team develops portfolio models, reporting frameworks, and decision‑support materials that guide both day‑to‑day management and long‑term planning. Joining the Flagship Portfolio Management team means contributing directly to the success of high‑profile funds in a dynamic, analytical, and collaborative environment

**Role

**You will play a key role in supporting the management and performance oversight of our flagship funds. You’ll gain exposure to high‑profile assets, collaborate with experienced professionals across the organization, and contribute directly to the performance of our flagship funds. It’s an ideal environment for someone who thrives in analytical, fast‑paced settings and wants to play a meaningful role in shaping portfolio outcomes.

**Responsibilities will consist of but are not limited to:

**

• Support the ongoing monitoring and analysis of portfolio performance across Flagship funds

• Maintain, update, and enhance portfolio models, dashboards, and reporting tools

• Prepare high‑quality materials for investment committees, senior management, and investor reporting

• Conduct financial analysis, scenario modelling, and forecasting to support strategic decision‑making

• Track key performance indicators, market trends, and asset‑level developments

• Identify risks and opportunities within the portfolio and support follow‑up actions

• Collaborate closely with investment teams, asset managers, and other internal stakeholders to ensure alignment with fund strategy

• Assist in preparing portfolio reviews, valuation updates, and fund‑level presentations

• Contribute to process improvements and the development of best‑practice portfolio management frameworks

**You

**You are holding a university degree in finance, economic, business or a related field and 1–4 years of relevant experience in investment management, portfolio management, corporate finance, consulting, or a similar analytical role.

**We look for the following in a candidate:

**

• Ability to interpret complex data and communicate insights clearly to senior stakeholders

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including proficiency in creating high-quality PowerPoint presentations

• Self-starter with a structured and disciplined approach to your work, the ability to connect the dots independently, and to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

• Solid financial modelling skills and solid understanding of valuation, forecasting, and performance analysis

• Excellent analytical and problem‑solving abilities, with a high level of attention to detail

• Proficiency in Excel; experience with BI tools or data analytics is a plus

• Comfortable working with large datasets and multiple information sources

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with cross‑functional teams

• High level of professionalism, ownership, and motivation to contribute to fund‑level decision‑making

**The process

**Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

**Building value that matters

**Founded in 2012, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners P/S (CIP) is a global fund manager and leading investor in energy infrastructure. CIP builds value that matters by developing and constructing critical infrastructure projects that shape the future of energy.

Through its funds, CIP invests in power generation (solar and wind), energy storage, transmission and distribution, advanced bioenergy, low-carbon fuels and carbon capture.

Are you looking for a position in which you can set direction and help shape our company? You will drive the development of pricing capabilities, help establish a stronger customer data foundation and turn commercial data into actionable insights that support decision-making across the business.

You will join our Commercial Excellence team, which works across DFDS to enable more efficient, data-driven and profitable commercial operations. Through common tools, processes and insights, we help strengthen commercial performance while supporting local business ownership and flexibility.

Be part of the movement - and play your part.

**

• Lead the digitalisation of pricing processes across CRM, contract management and pricing solutions

**At DFDS, we believe the strongest teams are built through diverse perspectives, experiences and ways of thinking.

• A strong track record of driving cross-functional initiatives and delivering results through collaboration and influence rather than formal authority

• Experience operating in complex organisations with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn data into actionable insights and recommendations

• The ability to communicate complex topics clearly and confidently to both operational teams and senior stakeholders

Working at DFDS

Are we a match? Then what are you waiting for? Apply Now.

Are you passionate about renewable energy and eager to work at the forefront of the global energy transition? PEAK Wind is seeking an AI Engineer to help shape our AI roadmap and to build and orchestrate the agents our colleagues and clients will use every day. At PEAK Wind, AI is moving from prototypes into production, and renewable energy operations produce exactly the kind of complex, high-volume data where AI can deliver significant value.

Introducing the Data & Intelligence Team

You will become part of our Data & Intelligence (D&I) team, where we work within PEAK Wind’s asset management service offering and manage full value chain data management for our clients. We support renewable energy assets worldwide through data management, reporting solutions, analytics, and AI capabilities, helping deliver data-driven solutions that support our clients and renewable energy projects. Our team consists of highly motivated professionals who bring diverse backgrounds and a strong commitment to excellence. We support one another, share knowledge, and celebrate both individual and collective achievements.

You will report to the Head of Data & Intelligence and work day-to-day with our small team of engineers who have been building internal AI products at PEAK Wind for several years. You will work closely with colleagues across different areas, bringing your perspective to a collaborative and purposeful team environment.

How You Will Make an Impact

As an AI Engineer, you will take AI solutions from idea to production and keep them there. You will co-own our AI roadmap: helping decide which agents we build, in what order, and what “working” means for each of them. Then you will build them.

Our agent portfolio serves two audiences. Internally, our agents give colleagues across PEAK Wind a well-governed way to work with company knowledge, generate reports, and analyse wind farm performance. Other internal agents help our own engineers specify and build new features faster. Externally, we provide agent-driven capabilities in our client-facing products.

On smaller initiatives you may be the engineer primarily responsible for taking the solution from first conversation to deployment. On larger initiatives, you will work closely with Product Owners, data engineers, and domain experts in asset management. Either way, the distance from an idea to something running is deliberately short. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Co-develop and maintain the PEAK Wind AI roadmap with the AI team, turning business needs into scoped, sequenced deliverables

• Design, build, and deploy agentic systems for internal colleagues, from reporting and wind farm analysis to engineering-productivity agents

• Design, build, and deploy AI-driven features and agents in our client-facing products, working with SCADA, operations, and asset management data

• Orchestrate multi-agent workflows: tool use, memory, retrieval over company and client data, and integration with our platform through APIs

• Build the evaluation systems that tell us whether an agent works, before and after it reaches production

• Own the data and infrastructure work behind your own agents on the cloud.

• Implement responsible-AI practices for operational energy data: access control, data isolation between clients, logging, and guardrails

• Ship early and iterate put prototypes in users’ hands fast and feed what you learn back into the roadmap

• Collaborate with Product Owners and stakeholders to understand what they need, and push back when AI is not the right tool

• Document what you build so others can maintain, extend, and trust it

What Will Make You Successful in This Role

At PEAK Wind, we know success comes in many forms. What matters most is your mindset, curiosity, and drive to make an impact. The following qualities and experiences will help you succeed in this role:

• A degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or similar, or an equivalent track record of shipping software

• Hands-on experience in software development, ML, data engineering, or AI Engineering, including AI applications you have helped take into production

• Strong Python and/or TypeScript, and hands-on experience with at least one agent framework

• Experience building or extending evals for LLM and agent behaviour, or an interest in developing deeper expertise in this area

• Experience building in cloud environments, preferably Microsoft Azure; familiarity with PostgreSQL, APIs, and modern web stacks is an advantage

• You code with AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor as a matter of course

• Professional experience in the energy industry or another complex technical environment; renewable energy or SCADA experience is an advantage but not required

• Clear and effective communication skills in English, both spoken and written, with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike

• A go-doer mentality: you would rather ship something real this week and improve it next week than perfect it in a document

• A structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to take initiative, including owning a product from idea to delivery

• The ability to stay calm and constructive in a high-paced environment

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to thrive in an international, cross-functional team

This role is designed for an engineer who has already gained some hands-on experience building AI solutions and is now looking to deepen that expertise in a highly practical, production-focused environment and enjoys building and learning.

Why Join PEAK Wind

• A real mandate to build with AI: an existing roadmap, internal users who want what you build, and clients ready to adopt it

• An international, inclusive, and diverse workplace where differences are valued

• The opportunity to work on leading renewable energy projects alongside experienced industry professionals

• Flexible working arrangements that support both your career and personal life

• A flat organisational structure where your ideas are welcomed and your contributions matter

• A strong focus on your learning, development, and professional growth

• A culture that values commitment, meaningful contributions, and having fun

Our Commitment to Inclusion and Fair Hiring

We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace drives innovation, creativity, and stronger results. At PEAK Wind, we are committed to fair and transparent hiring processes, welcoming candidates from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Our hiring decisions focus on what each person brings to the role and our team, and we are committed to ensuring transparent salary structures, with pay decisions based on clear, objective, and gender‑neutral criteria. Salary information, including the relevant salary band, will be shared with candidates when they are invited to a first interview.

How to Apply

We look forward to receiving your application. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been found. Please apply directly through our website. If you have any questions or would like to know more about the position, please contact People & Development at recruitment@peak-wind.com.

PEAK Wind is an independent renewable energy specialist in commercial, financial, and technical operations, delivering advisory, intelligence, and asset management services to investors and developers around the world. From onshore and offshore wind generation to Power-to-X, we work across the entire energy lifecycle to optimise operations and maintenance, enhance asset performance, and provide a holistic view of renewable infrastructure portfolios.

Our values - Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity - are reflected in everything we do, from how we support our clients to how we collaborate as a team. At PEAK Wind, you will be able to apply your professional skills in a dynamic environment and experience a meaningful responsibility and involvement.

Do you want to develop technical process solutions for customers across the world and play a key role in transforming customer requirements into competitive and reliable industrial systems? Then this could be your next position.

On behalf of Simatek A/S, we are looking for a Process Engineer who will become a central technical resource in the company's Process & Proposal team and contribute to the continued development of customer-specific process solutions for industries worldwide.

About Simatek

Simatek A/S is an international engineering company specializing in air filtration, pneumatic conveying, dust handling, and process solutions for industries such as food, feed, grain, recycling, minerals, and industrial manufacturing. The company designs and delivers customized systems that help customers improve operational efficiency, product quality, environmental performance, and workplace safety. From its headquarters in Albertslund in Denmark, Simatek serves customers around the world and combines strong engineering expertise with a flexible and customer-oriented approach.

The position

As Process & Application Engineer, you will become part of Simatek's international Process & Proposal team with colleagues in both Denmark and India. Focusing primarily on solutions for the food, dairy, feed and grain industries, you will transform customer requirements into technically robust and commercially competitive process solutions.

Working closely with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders, you will perform process calculations, size equipment, define system configurations and contribute to the development of tailored solutions that balance technical performance, cost efficiency and customer needs.

Your responsibilities will include

• Develop process solutions based on customer requirements and application data, identifying and solving technical issues in the process design

• Perform process calculations and system sizing for complete process installations

• Prepare and review process documentation

• Collaborate with suppliers regarding technical specifications and equipment selection

• Prepare technical proposals and quotations

• Contribute to the development and standardization of engineering tools, methods and solutions

• Work closely with R&D and the product management team to develop competitive solutions

• Support continuous improvement of process design standards and engineering practices

• Participate in occasional international travel for customer and technical meetings (approx. 20 days per year)

Your profile

We imagine you have a strong engineering background and experience developing process systems or technical solutions within industrial environments.

You likely bring:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree within Process Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Energy Engineering or a related discipline

• Experience within process engineering, system design or industrial solution development, with the ability to independently drive technical tasks

• Skilled in process calculations, equipment sizing and can read PFD and P&ID drawings

• Experience in preparing technical proposals, quotations or engineering project documentation is an advantage

• Experience from the food and dairy industry will be considered an advantage

• Professional proficiency in English. An additional language will be considered an advantage

As a person, you are analytical, solution-oriented and motivated by solving complex technical challenges. You work in a structured manner, take ownership of your tasks and enjoy collaborating across technical and commercial disciplines.

Why join Simatek?

You will join an entrepreneurial organization where the distance from idea to implementation is short, allowing you to make a tangible impact.

The role offers:

• Flexible working conditions including the possibility of working from home, up to two days per week by agreement

• Attractive compensation package including pension scheme, health insurance and performance bonus

• An active social environment and employee association arranging events throughout the year
